subject.title: CRITICAL: PR #103 SOURCE_CODE_REFERENCE_VALUES whitelist is too broad - allows any credential string to pass autoreview

question: Should the linked PR be narrowed to explicit safe value-reference patterns with negative real-credential tests before any merge?
rationale: The current-main code is narrower, but accepting the linked PR would change the secret-scanning trust boundary; deciding the acceptable provider-reference contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require narrow reference matching
options.body: Revise the linked PR so provider expressions are accepted only in the supported value-reference context and add negative credential-literal regression cases.

options.title: Reject provider-reference expansion
options.body: Leave the current explicit allowlist unchanged and close the linked PR if its desired source references cannot be added without weakening detection.

recommendation.title: Require narrow reference matching
recommendation.body: Revise the linked PR so provider expressions are accepted only in the supported value-reference context and add negative credential-literal regression cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work shows sustained ownership of autoreview credential-reference hardening.
